name: What is the typical cost range for a luxury rear-house addition in the Los Angeles area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a luxury rear-house addition in the Los Angeles area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a luxury rear-house addition in the Los Angeles area, including Glendale and Pasadena, varies significantly based on size, complexity, materials, and finishes. Generally, expect costs to start from approximately $400-$700 per square foot for high-end construction. This excludes design fees, permits, and soft costs. Factors like custom cabinetry, advanced smart home technology, premium flooring, and unique architectural features can push costs higher. A detailed estimate requires a thorough site assessment and design consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury rear-house additions in Los Angeles typically range from $400-$700+ per square foot, depending on size, complexity, and custom finishes.
